originality.rationale: The claimed arithmetic Frobenius splitting over F5 is not present in the inspected extremal-curve classification, geometric bitangent-orbit theorem, or accessible small-field quartic tables. The proof computes the actual descent of all 28 lines rather than claiming the previously known geometric formulas or automorphism orbits. Classical formulas permit the calculation, and an unindexed historical specialization remains a disclosed priority risk.
residual_risks: An older, unindexed arithmetic specialization of Edge/Cayley bitangent formulas to this F5 twist could already give the identical Frobenius cycle type.
Publisher full text for Edge (1938) was not accessible, so historical priority cannot be certified.
The result is a narrow field-of-definition classification: its significance is arithmetic theta-characteristic descent, not new geometric bitangent equations.

value.rationale: The exact arithmetic splitting of the full bitangent/odd-theta-characteristic set is a natural descent invariant of the unique Sziklai-optimal genus-three curve over F5. It determines the minimal 625-element field over which all bitangents become rational and exactly which quadratic extension produces four, information not supplied by the geometric 12+16 orbit classification; useful when analyzing rational odd theta characteristics and degree-two del Pezzo covers. Not merely a line-incidence recomputation or arbitrary parameter slice.
